name: Virabhadrasana II
description: A powerful standing pose that builds stamina, focus, and strength in the legs and core.

steps.instruction: Stand tall in the center of your mat, focusing your breath.
steps.voice_prompt: Stand tall, centering your weight and connecting with your breath.

steps.instruction: Step your feet wide apart, about four feet, hands on hips.
steps.voice_prompt: Step your feet wide apart, wider than your hips, and rest hands on your waist.

steps.instruction: Turn your left toes in and your right toes out forward.
steps.voice_prompt: Turn your left toes slightly inward, and turn your right toes out ninety degrees.

steps.instruction: Draw your navel in, tuck tailbone, and lengthen up through the spine.
steps.voice_prompt: Draw your navel in, tuck your tailbone slightly, and lengthen your spine upward.

steps.instruction: Inhale, reach right fingertips forward and left fingertips backward.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, stretch your arms out to the sides, reaching front and back fingertips wide.

steps.instruction: Exhale and bend your front knee, keeping the knee aligned over ankle.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, bend your front knee, keeping your shin perpendicular to the floor.

steps.instruction: Gaze over your right hand, breathing deeply into your chest.
steps.voice_prompt: Look over your right hand and hold the pose. Feel strong and stable.

steps.instruction: Inhale, straighten your leg, release hands, and return to center.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, straighten your front leg, lower your arms, and step your feet back together.
